hardwareUnitsSwitch2.label: Nintendo Switch 2 hardware units sold
hardwareUnitsSwitch2.definition: Nintendo Switch 2 hardware sales units by region (launched June 2025, so FY2026 is its first year), published in units of ten thousand and converted to units.

softwareUnitsSwitch2.label: Nintendo Switch 2 software units sold
softwareUnitsSwitch2.definition: Nintendo Switch 2 software sales units by region, packaged and downloadable versions, including units bundled with hardware or other products; excludes download-only software and add-on content. Published in ten-thousands, converted to units. Packaged versions of Nintendo Switch 2 Edition software count as Nintendo Switch 2 software and downloadable versions as Nintendo Switch software; upgrade packs are not counted.

hardwareUnits.label: Nintendo Switch hardware units sold
hardwareUnits.definition: Nintendo Switch hardware sales units (all models) by region, published in units of ten thousand and converted to units (shown in the bracketed note).

softwareUnits.label: Nintendo Switch software units sold
softwareUnits.definition: Nintendo Switch software sales units by region, packaged and downloadable versions of software, including units bundled with hardware or other products; excludes download-only software and add-on content. Published in ten-thousands, converted to units. Packaged versions of Nintendo Switch 2 Edition software count as Nintendo Switch 2 software and downloadable versions as Nintendo Switch software; upgrade packs are not counted.

notes: Unit sales by region (Japan, The Americas, Europe, Other) come from Nintendo's FY2026 Financial Results Explanatory Material (May 8, 2026). Nintendo Switch 2 launched in June 2025, so FY2026 is its first year; its hardware and software units are kept as their own metrics next to the original Nintendo Switch family (all models), and the two platforms are not added together. The regions are Nintendo's own and are not defined by country. PP&E by country (annual report, current fiscal year): Japan ¥89,122M, U.S. ¥28,142M, Other ¥10,185M; only the U.S. is recorded as a row because the Japan row carries unit sales from a different document. Employees: 8,666 group-wide at March 31, 2026; the annual report gives employees only for the parent (3,084) and by major facility (HQ 2,743, Uji Plant 145, Tokyo Branch 196, Nintendo of America 1,603, Nintendo of Europe 1,152), shown in sites. Revenue by geography is already in the records and not repeated. Hosted on nintendo.co.jp (company), the English version of the annual securities report.
